hook: Aleksa Gordić studied electrical engineering with a focus on computer science and electronics, graduating in 2017. He worked as a machine learning engineer at Microsoft from 2018 to 2021 before joining Google DeepMind as a research engineer in 2021. In 2020 he started The AI Epiphany, a YouTube channel and blog that walks viewers through deep learning papers and code, and he published open source reimplementations of models such as Graph Attention Networks and the original Transformer. He left DeepMind in 2023 to focus on independent research and teaching, and led development of YugoGPT, an open large language model for Serbian and neighboring South Slavic languages. In 2025 he joined P-1 AI, a startup building AI systems for physical world engineering tasks.
